# jev-superpowers: Systematic Software Engineering with Jev System One Reflex Gates

> Drop-in agentic skills framework upgrading software engineering workflows with TypeSafe AI Jev System One typed decisions, sub-second gates, and lifecycle hooks.

## Framework Overview
jev-superpowers wraps upstream software engineering methodologies (obra/superpowers) with TypeSafe AI Jev System One typed decisions:
- Choice: Discrete selection with confidence (routing, branch selection)
- Score: Continuous multi-variable score with confidence (dependency vetting, smell scoring)
- Noul: Calibrated probability (limpet stop-hook, command safety)

## Supported Agent Platforms
- Claude Code (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, marketplace.json)
- Cursor (.cursor-plugin/plugin.json, hooks-cursor.json)
- Codex (.codex-plugin/plugin.json)
- OpenCode (.opencode/plugins/superpowers.js)
- Devin (.devin-plugin/plugin.json)
- Hermes (.hermes-plugin/plugin.yaml)
- Gemini CLI (gemini-extension.json)
- Pi Agent (.pi/extensions/superpowers.ts)
